blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two counts of criminal and administrative cases against Sens. Mark and Camille Villar, parents and former Sens. Manny and Cynthia Villar, and businessman Paolo Villar, and officials for alleged questionable joint venture agreements entered into by Prime Water Infrastructure Corporation (PWIC). Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano said that the Ombudsman received a report from the Office of the Government Corporate Council that 75 local water districts entered into a joint venture agreement with Prime Water Infrastructure Corporation (PWIC) from 2015 to 2022.
